about: Gold set for my_kb/: DFARS, CMMC, SPRS and ITAR excerpts. 6 answerable, 2 unanswerable.

questions.question: How quickly does a defense contractor have to report a cyber incident to the DoD?
evidence: within 72 hours of discovery of any cyber incident

questions.question: How long must a contractor keep images of affected systems after reporting a cyber incident?
evidence: for at least 90 days from the submission of the cyber incident report

questions.question: Who performs a CMMC Level 3 certification assessment?
evidence: which will be performed by DCMA DIBCAC

questions.question: What minimum score does a contractor need to get Conditional Level 2 status with a POA&M?
evidence: is greater than or equal to 0.8

questions.question: How many business days does a contractor get to provide additional evidence for the findings of a Medium or High assessment?
evidence: the contractor has 14 business days to provide additional information

questions.question: Does showing technical data to a foreign national inside the US count as an export under ITAR?
evidence: to a foreign person in the United States (a deemed export)
